chunks: And from his instruction to him (peace be upon him): He issued this instruction to Shurayh ibn Hanī when he appointed him at the head of the vanguard contingent to Syria.

key_terms.إِلَى الشَّامِ: To Syria, the region of military campaign
key_terms.شُرَيْحَ بْنَ هَانِئٍ: Shurayh ibn Hanī, a companion of Imam Ali
key_terms.مَقْدَمَتِهِ: The vanguard contingent or vanguard force

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam Ali appoint as the commander of the vanguard to Syria in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This opening line from Nahj al-Balagha establishes the historical setting of Imam Ali’s (AS) military campaign against the Syrians, specifically identifying Shurayh ibn Hanī as the commander of the vanguard. It highlights the scholarly tradition of treating such appointments not merely as administrative acts but as opportunities for transmitting comprehensive ethical and strategic guidance to military leaders.
